name: echo-notify
description: Second, NON-telegram LISTENER for the canonical `solve-captcha` event: appends the hand-off request to a local JSONL log (and echoes it on stderr). It exists to prove delivery is decoupled from the solver and from any single channel: it can be bound to the same event as the telegram listener, either can be enabled alone, and neither is referenced by the solver.

config_schema.label: notification log path
config_schema.description: JSONL file the listener appends every received solve-captcha event to.

config_schema.label: listener mode
config_schema.description: log = append and return ok; fail = return an error (used to prove one failing listener breaks neither the solver nor the other listeners).
